quiz_title: Class 44: Kyarey koina avgun ke doshni vat na karvi

questions.question_text: Bhagwānno bhakta hoy tene sauthī vishesh potāmā shu bhāse?
questions.explanation: Vachanamrut Gadhada Madhyanu 26 states: Bhagwānno bhakta hoy tene to sauthī vishesh potāmā ja avaguṇ bhāse.

questions.question_text: Je bījāmā avaguṇ jue ane potāmā guṇ paraṭhe te satsangī hoy to paṇ kem kaheVāy chhe?
questions.explanation: According to Vachanamrut Gadhada Madhyanu 26: Ane je bījāmā avaguṇ jue ane potāmā guṇ paraṭhe te to satsangī chhe to paṇ ardho vimukh chhe.

questions.question_text: Swami ni Vato pramāṇe, 'asevā' te shu chhe?
questions.explanation: Swa. Vato: 2/132 defines: Te asevā te shu je avaguṇ levo.

questions.question_text: Amārī āgaḷ je koī Bhagwānnā bhaktanu _______ bole te to amne dīṭho ja game nahī.
questions.explanation: Vachanamrut Gadhada Antya 21 states: Amārī āgaḷ je koī Bhagwānnā bhaktanu ghasātu bole te to amne dīṭho ja game nahī.

questions.question_text: Je Bhagwānnā bhaktano avaguṇ leto hoy tenā hāthnu Maharaj ne shu na bhāve?
questions.explanation: As per Vachanamrut Gadhada Antya 21: Ane je Bhagwānnā bhaktano avaguṇ leto hoy tenā hāthnu to anna-jaḷ paṇ bhāve nahī.

questions.question_text: Dehno sambandhī hoy paṇ jo Bhagwānnā bhaktano avaguṇ le to te sāthe shu thaī jāy?
questions.explanation: Vachanamrut Gadhada Antya 21 states: Ane dehno sambandhī hoy paṇ jo Bhagwānnā bhaktano avaguṇ le to te sāthe paṇ atishay kuhet thaī jāy.

questions.question_text: Swami ni Vato pramāṇe, jo koī nitye lākh rūpiyā lāve paṇ satsangnu ghasātu bolto hoy to shu thāy?
questions.explanation: Swa. Vato: 1/237 says: Nitye lākh rūpiyā lāve ne satsangnu ghasātu bolto hoy to te mane na game.

questions.question_text: Evo koṇ chhe jeni chākarī Maharaj karāvavānu kahe chhe?
options: je sūto sūto khāy paṇ Bhagwānnā bhaktnu sāru bolto hoy
questions.correct_answer: je sūto sūto khāy paṇ Bhagwānnā bhaktnu sāru bolto hoy
questions.explanation: Swa. Vato: 1/237 explains: ...ne sūto sūto khāy paṇ Bhagwānnā bhaktnu sāru bolto hoy to tenī chākarī hu karāvu, evo māro swabhāv chhe.

questions.question_text: Je satsangī satsangmānthī pāchho paḍvāno hoy tene pratham to divse divse _________ avaguṇ āve chhe.
questions.explanation: Vachanamrut Gadhada Pratham 28 describes: Je satsangī satsangmānthī pāchho paḍvāno hoy tene pratham to divse divse satsangīmātrano avaguṇ āve chhe...

questions.question_text: Jem kshayrog koī oshadhe karīne maṭe nahī, tem jene Bhagwān ne Bhagwānnā bhaktano avaguṇ āvyo hoy tenā hṛudaymānthī kyārey shu na ṭaḷe?
questions.explanation: Vachanamrut Gadhada Antya 12 states: ...jem kshayrog thayo hoy te koī oshadhe karīne maṭe ja nahī, tem jene Bhagwān ne Bhagwānnā bhaktano avaguṇ āvyo hoy tenā hṛudaymānthī kyārey āsurī mati ṭaḷe nahī...
